about.heading: Agya Sounds
about.subtitle: Third Eye Frequencies
about.description: We are a psytrance record label. Through Darkpsy subgenres, we create sonic experiences that function as portals to elevated states of consciousness.

artists.title: ARTISTS
artists.description: Our artists channel third eye frequencies. Each sonic project is a spiritual journey, connecting technology, nature and expanded consciousness.

artistsGallery.title: MEET THE ARTISTS
artistsGallery.description: AGYA SOUNDS presents producers and DJs from its roster for psytrance events focused on advanced psychedelia.

releases.title: LATEST RELEASES
releases.description: Dive into the forefront of experimental psychedelia. With 150+ songs released, our curation focuses on consciousness expansion through high-fidelity Darkpsy. Explore recent releases below or browse our Bandcamp for the complete discography.

item1.description: A sonic wizard commands darkpsy sorcery where each track is a chapter and each drop a new enchantment. Twisted textures, dancing grooves and deep distortions in a hypnotic narrative for the darkest dancefloors.

item2.description: New Agya Sounds EP by Koothan, presents a deep and organic darkpsy journey, with dense textures, hypnotic rhythms and dancefloor energy. Free download for the community.

item3.description: Absycho dives into mental landscapes where pulsing frequencies act as keys — opening portals and awakening the silent light of the pineal gland.

item4.description: Mandinga debuts on Agya Sounds with a capoeira-inspired sonic spell: cunning, rhythm and flow. Deep-driving basslines and high-BPM passages (169 and 180) keep the groove visceral in an EP of mystery and trance that gives you chills and pulls you straight to the center of the floor.

demo.title: SEND YOUR DEMO
demo.description: We look for authentic Darkpsy. Send your SoundCloud or Google Drive link (WAV, 44.1kHz, 24-bit) mixed at -6dB. Show us your sonic evolution.

contact.title: CONTACT
contact.heading: Want to release your music or get in touch with Agya Sounds?
contact.body1: We are always open to discovering new artists and new sonorities within the Darkpsy universe!
contact.body2: From progressive to high bpm (130 to 200 BPM).
contact.body3: We value authenticity, quality, sonic identity and artistic evolution.
contact.body4: If you want to submit material, share your SoundCloud or Google Drive link (WAV, 44.1kHz, 24-bit), mixed at -6dB.
contact.body5: We want to hear your essence and follow your sonic journey.
contact.body6: We are also happy to talk if you want to organize a Night, propose a collaboration or simply ask a question.
contact.body7: Fill out the form with your name, e-mail and message. — We will reply as soon as possible.

footer.about1: Founded in 2018 in São Paulo, Brazil, Agya Sounds represents the sounds of the Third Eye.
footer.about2: Amidst a chaotic society, our music serves as a lighthouse, guiding the listener to a higher state of consciousness and spiritual connection.
footer.about3: Our curation focuses on variations of Darkpsy and intense psychedelia, designed not just to be heard, but to be felt.
footer.about4: We believe in the power of music to transcend time and space. With Agya, you don't just listen — you awaken.
